notes: The interviewer's voices (V1.1_PLAN P4). LFM3-Audio speaks only where its model runs on a GPU; on a processor it is too slow (real-time factor 1.4, 08/11/2026) and a Piper voice speaks instead. Piper packages are sherpa-onnx's tts-models release assets, pinned by the SHA-256 GitHub publishes for them, and are downloaded on first use. A voice's licence is its training data's: hfc_female and ryan were trained on CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 recordings and may be used only non-commercially.
